name: Monochrome Fullscreen
description: Resource-efficient Monochrome-inspired fullscreen now-playing view for the server-hosted Jellyfin Web client.
overview: Fullscreen now-playing view for Jellyfin Web

versions.changelog: Fix invisible word-timed TTML lyrics and replace the CD bullseye with a transparent center cutout and thin silver ring.
Add the responsive Monochrome-style lyrics layout, synchronized Jellyfin and TTML lyrics, stable pause-aware background motion, and refined circular player geometry.
Use Monochrome's actual Kawarp WebGL background, fix play/pause and mute icon state, and retain the lightweight renderer as a compatibility fallback.
Rebuild the fullscreen presentation from Monochrome's current compact media-column layout, replace emoji controls with SVG icons, cover Jellyfin's native player, and soften the ambient effect.
Initial MVP with fullscreen audio overlay, playback controls, keyboard and D-pad input, and an adaptive single-canvas visualizer.
